instruction: Implement EVERY card in this pack. Clone from clone_path; match effect_text. Use duel_helpers.h. Spells: only edit the listed .c file. Activated/permanent may need monster_effects.h / dispatcher — serialize those. Do not leave TODO bodies. One make at the end of the whole batch.

You can discard this card to the Graveyard; add 1 A Legendary Ocean from your Deck to your hand. You can discard this card to the Graveyard; add 1 A Legendary Ocean from your Deck to your hand.
If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing Battle Damage to your opponent. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing Battle Damage to your opponent.

If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Special Summon 1 "Troop Dragon" from your Deck. If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Special Summon 1 Troop Dragon from your Deck.
